name: OP/ED
description: Put opening and ending theme files (video, audio or both) in a folder, one folder per show. The plugin matches them to your shows and seasons, adds song title, artists and episode ranges from AnimeThemes.moe, and serves them to clients through an authenticated API. Missing a theme? It can cut one out of your own episodes from their chapter markers, for you to review. Developed primarily with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code); see the README.
overview: Anime openings and endings for your shows, matched from a folder you fill.

versions.changelog: Publishes your themes as two Jellyfin libraries, kept up to date after every scan: a Music Videos library of the theme videos (links to the playable copies, with song, artists, show, season and episodes, a picture from the video, and Spoiler/NSFW tags; NSFW gets an adult rating for parental controls) and a Music library of their songs, an album per show with the show's art. Playlists, favourites and watched state then work as for anything else in Jellyfin. Turn it on and create both libraries from the Setup tab. For clients: themes now give their library items' ids, GET /OpEd/Library gives the libraries' ids, and GET /OpEd/LibraryItems/{id}/Theme gives the theme behind a library item.

A tidier settings page: Setup, Review and Library tabs. Clips are grouped by show, with Approve all and Reject all, keyboard shortcuts and previews on request. The library list can be searched and filtered, and a bar stays at the bottom while approved clips wait to be added to the library. New Rescan files button per show: replace a theme file, press it, and the plugin picks it up, makes it playable in the themes folder and moves the original to an _originals folder.

Works without Shokofin: AniList, MyAnimeList and Kitsu ids, then a title search (ten shows to a request, with an adjustable threshold), and seasons matched by premiere date. The editor says how each theme got its season and lets you type any AniDB id. Not-found shows are retried after 1, 3 and 7 days, then every 30. Duplicate AnimeThemes entries no longer override the main one, and themes now report overlap and whether a creditless version exists.
Same as 0.1.2.1 (settings page fix); re-released so the plugin repository lists it.

Looks themes up through the AnimeThemes GraphQL API with the user agent agreed with them. Season picker and OP/ED number on approval, library picker and a length hint for the chapter clip review queue, previews that stay put while clips are being cut, credit to AnimeThemes in the README and settings page.

- 0.1.0.0: First version. Indexes OP/ED theme files, matches them to shows and seasons, song details from AnimeThemes.moe, themes.json and file names, MP4/M4A copies for Apple TV, client API, and cutting missing OPs/EDs from episode chapters into a review queue.
